title: (docs) Rewrite the openmrs CLI README around how it's used
body:
## Requirements

- [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/en-US/docs/frontend-modules/contributing/#contributing-guidelines) label. See existing PR titles for inspiration.
- [ ] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui))
- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.
- [ ] I have updated the esm-framework and storybook mocks ([mock.tsx](https://github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-core/blob/main/packages/framework/esm-framework/mock.tsx), [mock-jest.tsx](https://github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-core/blob/main/packages/framework/esm-framework/mock-jest.tsx), and [storybook mocks](https://github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-core/blob/main/packages/tooling/storybook/mocks/)) to reflect any API changes.

## Summary

The `openmrs` README only listed the four commands with a one-line example each, so most of what the CLI does wasn't written down anywhere. This rewrites it around the three places it's used:

- developing a frontend module with `openmrs develop`
- building a distribution with `openmrs assemble` and `openmrs build`
- the `rspack` and `webpack` commands and shared configs that modules build with

Each section covers the options, the config file formats, and the behaviour that's easy to miss. For example, `build --fresh` also deletes what `assemble` wrote, the build config wins over flags except for `importmap`, `routes` and `defaultLocale`, and the default `importmap` and `routes` URLs are relative to the current page. It also links to the reference application's setup for serving the compressed copies and for filling in per-deployment settings with `envsubst`.

A couple of current limitations are called out directly: `assets` in the build config is ignored, and relative local paths in the build config aren't resolved against the working directory. Those notes can come out when the fixes land.

The `--help` epilog had drifted as well. It said `configPaths` and `configUrls` are comma-separated (they're JSON arrays), described `spa-assemble-config.json` as the file both commands read, and was missing `routes`, `defaultLocale`, `env` and `frontendModuleExcludes`. It now matches the code and links to the README.
